# Danny On The Air (danny.vn)

> Personal site of Danny, a security engineer in Vietnam building open-source
> security-as-code CLIs, evidence-only regulatory & compliance AI (RAG + MCP),
> and Go SDKs.

## Security as Code

All three ship a built-in MCP server; every mutation is dry-run by default.

- [splunkctl](https://github.com/dannyota/splunkctl): operate Splunk Enterprise SIEM + Splunk SOAR as code
- [s1ctl](https://github.com/dannyota/s1ctl): operate SentinelOne Singularity Platform as code
- [secopsctl](https://github.com/dannyota/secops): operate Google SecOps (Chronicle SIEM + Siemplify SOAR) as code

## Regulatory AI

One codebase (github.com/dannyota/banhmi), one corpus per country — six ASEAN
jurisdictions. Free remote MCP endpoints (Streamable HTTP), no signup.
Tools: search, document, corpus_status, quality_gaps, guide.

- [banhmi](https://banhmi.danny.vn): Vietnamese banking & fintech regulation (MCP: banhmi.danny.vn/mcp, ask in Vietnamese)
- [laksa](https://laksa.danny.vn): Malaysian banking & fintech regulation (MCP: laksa.danny.vn/mcp, ask in English)
- [rendang](https://rendang.danny.vn): Indonesian banking & fintech regulation (MCP: rendang.danny.vn/mcp, ask in Indonesian)
- [kaya](https://kaya.danny.vn): Singaporean banking & fintech regulation (MCP: kaya.danny.vn/mcp, ask in English)
- [tomyum](https://tomyum.danny.vn): Thai banking & fintech regulation (MCP: tomyum.danny.vn/mcp, ask in Thai)
- [amok](https://amok.danny.vn): Cambodian banking & fintech regulation (MCP: amok.danny.vn/mcp, ask in English)

## Compliance AI

- [compliary](https://github.com/dannyota/compliary): evidence-only corpus + MCP server
  for the security control frameworks organizations are audited against — ISO/IEC 27001
  family (27001/27002/27017/27018/27701), ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST CSF 2.0,
  NIST SP 800-53 r5, SOC 2, PCI DSS v4.0.1, CIS Controls v8.1, SWIFT CSCF, CSA CCM v4.1,
  COBIT 2019. Framework text is licensed, so operators self-deploy their own instance;
  there is no shared public endpoint.

## Go SDKs (vanity imports on danny.vn)

- danny.vn/s1: SentinelOne Singularity
- danny.vn/secops: Google SecOps
- danny.vn/fortigate: FortiGate firewall REST API
- danny.vn/fortimgr: FortiManager FlatUI API
- danny.vn/nessus: Tenable Nessus scanner (read-only)
- danny.vn/vngcloud: VNG Cloud IAM
- danny.vn/gnode: VNG Cloud GreenNode services (unofficial community SDK)
- danny.vn/kaggle: Kaggle API

## Other

- [offthebook](https://github.com/dannyota/offthebook): memory-only Windows PE execution research
- [onnxruntime/go](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29615): Go bindings for ONNX Runtime C API via CGO (open PR on microsoft/onnxruntime)
- [flowcvcli](https://github.com/dannyota/flowcvcli): FlowCV résumé CLI
- All repositories: https://github.com/dannyota
